title: Mobile SSH server recipe
description: Declarative server-side install/launch steps. The host shows the literal `run` commands in a consent dialog before executing any of them over SSH.

requires.description: Optional preconditions the host probes before offering to run (e.g. docker present).

uninstall.description: Optional cleanup steps run on the server when the user removes the plugin and chooses 'also remove from server'. Best-effort (non-zero exit is ignored); shown for consent like install steps.

description.description: Human-readable explanation shown beside the command in the consent dialog.

run.description: The EXACT shell command to run on the remote (may contain {{vars}}). Shown verbatim to the user.

check.description: Idempotency probe; if it exits 0 the step is already satisfied and is skipped.

sudo.description: Whether the command needs root; the host surfaces this prominently.

stream.description: Run via execStreaming so output (and captures) arrive live (e.g. install logs, auth URLs).

capture.description: Map of variable name -> regex with one capture group, applied to stdout. Captured values are returned to the plugin and usable in serviceUrl as {{var}}.

forwardPort.description: After this step, open the default tunnel to this remote port.
